result.summary: The page is generally polished, but the horizontal carousels have awkward right-edge clipping that makes content look broken. No critical issues are visible.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” row extends beyond the viewport, cutting off its image, restaurant name, and delivery fee at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Implement a properly constrained horizontal carousel with consistent side padding and snapping. Truncate card text with an ellipsis within each card rather than clipping it at the viewport.

issues.description: The category row shows a partially visible chip after “Healthy” with no readable label, which appears like an accidentally clipped control.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel spacing or scroll position so the next chip is either meaningfully visible as a scroll cue or fully outside the viewport.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the lower restaurant card, hiding part of its image while browsing.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the navigation bar and safe-area height so the final content can scroll fully above the fixed navigation.
